fields.name: backgroundImage
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: The photo behind the whole section, the stat cards included.

fields.name: backgroundImageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Describes the photo for screen readers. At most 125 characters.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Two lines at most. Warning: text longer than 25 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: scrollLabel
fields.label: Scroll label
fields.description: The label beside the mouse icon. Warning: text longer than 12 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: The small line at the top of the card. Only the first 3 Stat Cards are shown. Warning: text longer than 32 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: statValue
fields.label: Stat value
fields.description: The big figure, e.g. 1,000+ or 44 YRS. Warning: text longer than 8 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Two lines at most under the figure. Warning: text longer than 80 characters is cut short with “…”.
